## Changes since `v0.6.1-beta.8`

### Features

- make the title bar transfers button say what is moving: its icon was always the download arrow, even with only uploads queued, and a spinner replaced it while anything ran; it now shows the upload, download, delete or both-ways icon for the active transfers (the history when none is active), rings the icon with the share of bytes moved, and counts the active transfers, the failed ones once idle, or all of them; it also gets the aria-label and tooltip it lacked ([bf35df3b](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/bf35df3b4ddddca16ab8b2f99412b9b8b2c41b5f))

### UI and usability

- name the folder an SFTP drop uploads to: the drop overlay said only "current directory", which is easy to misread with several tabs open, so it now prints the path below the hint, on one line cut at the end with the full path on hover; the arrow also floats gently while files are over the drawer, unless the system asks for reduced motion ([5e48f0c2](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/5e48f0c2df687cdccbd11c5e1cf4906e86656d4d))
- tell transfer rows apart at a glance: upload and download sat in the same gray box with only the arrow differing, so the direction box is now tinted per direction (sky, violet, gray for delete; fixed hues because one theme's primary is green, the color of done) and the status moves onto its corner as a small badge, freeing the right side for the file name; a delete shows Trash2 like the SFTP toolbar, and Remove, which also used Trash2, becomes X; the cancel and remove buttons and the direction box get accessible names ([8dc709b5](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/8dc709b50ba90821a743cc9e2f792595d5b86061))
- draw upload and download with one set of icons: context menus used the Upload and Download tray glyphs while the SFTP toolbar and the transfers panel used ArrowUpFromLine and ArrowDownToLine, so the same action looked different in each place; menus now use the arrows too, an SFTP entry's Download shows FileDown or FolderDown for one file or folder, and Upload Files is FileUp so it pairs with Upload Folder's FolderUp ([7216b970](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/7216b970972afea483f31fc4e3ad22630c7b8913))
- make the CentOS and openSUSE distro icons readable on a dark background: CentOS was the one-color mark in its darkest navy and openSUSE the SUSE corporate chameleon in deep pine, about 1.3:1 against a dark theme, while every other icon is above 2.2:1; CentOS is now its official four-color pinwheel and openSUSE its own circle mark in its brand green, which also matches the name it is shown under ([ec12966a](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/ec12966a3c8bd692ac971d9e0469dba88ee217af))
